CustomField.description: SOQL or Tooling API query to execute for this checklist item. For MetadataQuery type, this is a Tooling API query string. For SOQLValidation type, this is a SOQL query against standard objects. For CustomApex type, this field may contain a configuration JSON string passed to the executor class. Runtime validation of query syntax is handled by the MetadataIntegrityService.
CustomField.label: Query
